description:
## [1.0.0-dev.3](https://github.com/virzak/morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.0-dev.2...v1.0.0-dev.3) (2026-10-30)

### ✨ New Features

* **instagram:** show Download on home-feed reels ([#8](https://github.com/virzak/morphe-patches/issues/8)) ([d687f47](https://github.com/virzak/morphe-patches/commit/d687f47d2f71ec32d434ad2f76bf5485d684bf3f))

patches.name: Download media
patches.description: Adds a "Download" option to the post and reel "..." menus to save photos and videos to the gallery.

patches.name: Bypass device lock requirement
patches.description: Stops the app from refusing to start unless the phone has a lockscreen PIN, pattern or password set. Also keeps the app running after it has been re-signed, which its tamper check would otherwise treat as a compromised device and shut the app down on launch.

patches.name: Custom branding icon
patches.description: Adds a badge to the launcher icon so the patched app is distinguishable from an unpatched install.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Prevents the ad SDK from starting, which stops banner ads and pre-roll video ads.

patches.name: Enable background playback
patches.description: Allows playback to continue when the app is not in the foreground, which is otherwise only available with a paid subscription.

patches.name: Lift download restrictions
patches.description: Allows downloading videos the app otherwise refuses, either because the uploader disabled downloads or because the video is longer than six hours.

patches.name: Unlock subscription features
patches.description: Reports the account as subscribed to the app itself, which enables features gated behind a paid subscription such as background playback. Anything the server enforces is unaffected.

repoDescription: Morphe patch source (RuTube and more). Add: github.com/virzak/morphe-patches
